ms.promise:
Pooltool site will be operational. As per reviewer feedback this will include the following specific outputs:
・ Uptime monitoring - SLA of 95% uptime. (meaning on tip within 10 blocks of the tip (normally we target 6))
・Live data from pools reporting will be working - This is already captured with the uptimerobot data. if the reported data is more than 10 blocks from the tip (either way) then it will be captured as a fail.
・Live stake will be working - a test will be developed to compare live stake for a subset of pools against db-sync. Due to complexities of syncronizing live stake to a specific block height between db-sync and pooltool we will analyze a subset of the pools to confirm live stake is working properly. We will do this once per quarter.
・Reward data will be up to date - we will demonstrate that reward data is provided for the most recently completed epoch.
・PoolTool code will be open source still
・Pooltool will be running on the latest node release within 2 weeks of such a release.
・Pooltool load time will be under 4 seconds for the main page (https://pooltool.io/) without caching
